plainText:
Ruby (Japanese: サファイア Sapphire) is a character from Pokémon Ruby-Sapphire who first appeared in Something Happened!! Let's Go After Pikachu!!. He is based on from and is 's rival.

==Character==
Ruby has a big interest in Pokémon from Kanto, especially  . This is also shown in his house where he has a big collection of them.

==History==
Red leaves Pikachu and alone for a few minutes which gave Ruby the chance to bargain a trade with Pikachu. Ruby distracted Clefairy by giving him loads of food. As Clefairy got occupied with the food, Ruby switched him for . Ruby than arrives in his house and has Pikachu join in with the other Pokémon from Kanto. Clefairy spies on him after Treecko told Red what happened. To get Pikachu back, Clefairy disguises half of himself as a man and half as a woman to distract Ruby while and Treecko break through the window to steal Pikachu back. When they did the plan, Ruby and Pikachu become surprised about this and the group managed to get Pikachu back and return Treecko to Ruby.

==Trivia==
His and 's original names were switched in Chuang Yi's English translation of the manga, possibly to match the names of corresponding characters in Pokémon Adventures manga.
